name: Balthilde

skills.name: Cryoshatter Strike
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 8 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it

skills.name: Reinforcement Protocol
skills.description:
Selects an empty tile within a 8 tile radius and summons Defense Construct on the selected tile. If Defense Construct is already summoned, it is moved to the selected tile

If Demolition Protocol hasn't been used on this turn, Balthilde can use Demolition Protocol once

When Defense Construct is destroyed, this skill enters into a 3 turn cooldown

skills.name: Demolition Protocol
skills.description:
Selects an empty tile within a 8 tile radius and summons Offense Construct on the selected tile. If Offense Construct is already summoned, it is moved to the selected tile

If Reinforcement Protocol hasn't been used on this turn, Balthilde can use Reinforcement Protocol once

When Offense Construct is destroyed, this skill enters into a 3 turn cooldown

skills.name: Raging Chainblast
skills.description:
Selects a direction and deals AoE Physical damage equivalent to 100% ATK to all enemies in a 6 tile fan shaped area towards the selected direction

Decreases the cooldown of Reinforcement Protocol and Demolition Protocol by 1 turn

skills.name: Wrench Calibration
skills.description:
After performing a basic attack, increases Confectance Index by 1 point. When allies (excluding self) deals Physical damage using an active attack, increases Confectance Index by 1 point for self. This can be triggered up to 2 times per turn.

For each point of Confectance Index gained, applies 1 stack of Performance Breakthrough to all Construct. When a Construct with 10 stacks of Performance Breakthrough is destroyed, deals Physical damage equivalent to 100% of the Construct DEF to all enemies within a 3 tile radius. This will not trigger Interceptions, Counterattacks or Action Supports

summons.name: Defense Construct
summons.description: Inherits Balthilde's attributes and protects allies and Cover within a 3 tile radius.

skills.name: Safety Consciousness
skills.description: Upon summoned, applies Defense Up I for 2 turns and restores HP equivalent to 100% DEF for all allies within a 3 tile radius

skills.name: Focused Maintenance
skills.description: Cover within a 3 tile radius will not lose durability. Decreases damage received by 30% for allies within range that are not benefitting from damage reduction by Cover

summons.name: Offense Construct
summons.description: Inherits Balthilde's attributes and attacks the nearest enemy within a 3 tile radius.

skills.name: Disassembly Knack
skills.description: Selects the nearest enemy target within a 3 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 100% DEF to it. This can be used twice per turn

fortification.effect: Increases the range of Disassembly Knack to 5 tiles, and applies Stress Fracture on the target for 2 turns

Increases the range of Safety Consciousness and Focused Maintenance to 5 tiles

New effect is added for Safety Consciousness - Upon summoned, restores the durability of all Cover within a 5 tile radius

New effect is added for Focused Maintenance - Restores HP equivalent to 100% DEF and 2 Stability, and applies Defense Up I for all allies within a 5 tile radius at the end of their action

Resets the cooldown of Reinforcement Protocol and Demolition Protocol

Restores HP equivalent to 100% ATK for all allies, and applies Load-Bearing Parts for 2 turns

Decreases the cooldown of this skill by 1 turn. Increases the ATK and DEF inherited by Offense Construct to 100%

Increases the number of times Disassembly Knack can be used per turn by 1

Decreases the cooldown of this skill by 1 turn. Increases the ATK and DEF inherited by Defense Construct to 100%

Enhances the effects of Safety Consciousness - Upon summoned, restores HP equivalent to 200% DEF and 4 Stability

Enhances the effects of Focused Maintenance - Damage reduction is applied to all allies instead

For each point of Confectance Index held, increases the damage multiplier of Cryoshatter Strike by 5%

Enhances the effects of Performance Breakthrough - Increases ATK and DEF by 5%

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Cannot Spit It Out
keys.effect: Before using an active attack, applies Stress Fracture on the enemy for 2 turns

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Impatient
keys.effect: At the start of the battle, increases Confectance Index by 3 points

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Misunderstood Intention
keys.effect: At the end of the action, applies Damage Reduction II for all allies not near to Cover for 1 turn

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Fault Elimination Module
keys.effect: At the end of the action, restores 3 Stability for the ally with the lowest Stability

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Practical Modifications
keys.effect: Before allies are attacked, Defense Construct restores 1 Stability for them

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Mechanical Control
keys.effect: When a Construct is on the field, increases Stability damage dealt by self by 3 points

keys.name: Common Key - Adept Smith
keys.effect: HP +5% / Increases DEF for the holder's Physical Summon by 7%

keys.name: Expansion Key - Steel Awakening
keys.effect:
After using ultimate skill Raging Chainblast, if the active skill Reinforcement Protocol or Demolition Protocol is not on cooldown, Balthilde may use this skill. The Confectance Index cost of the ultimate skill Raging Chainblast is reduced to 4 points.
Constructs gain additional effects based on the number of Performance Breakthrough stacks:
0: Balthilde gains 4 points of Confectance Index and Constructs cleanse 1 debuff from ally units withing 5 tiles.
2: Defense of any ally units within 5 tiles from Constructs is increased by 20%. Does not stack.
5: When using ultimate skill Raging Chainblast and there are Constructs fwithing the area of effect, trigger the damaging death effect of the passive skill Wrench Calibration for them. Each stack of Performance Breakthrough increases the damage multiplier of the death effect by 20%.
